title: Reinstatement Charge Carried by the Opening Charge of a Pro Upgrade Term
content:
Collections desk rule. The reinstatement charge taken off the credit basis of a Professional Email Pro upgrade is the reinstatement charge the opening renewal charge carried — the renewal charge whose period start is the term start date. It is read from the days the subscription had been suspended when that charge was billed: the calendar days from the term start date to the charge date of the opening renewal charge, less the product's payment grace days (7 on Harborline Mail products, 10 on Microsoft 365 Business products), less 1.

- 15 days or more carried a reinstatement charge of 20.00, taken off the credit basis.
- From 4 up to 14 days carried 10.00.
- Fewer days, or no renewal charge on record, carried none.

## Worked cases (hypothetical Harborline Mail subscription, grace of 7 days)

| Days from term start to the charge date of the opening renewal charge | Days suspended | Reinstatement charge taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 3 | none |
| 12 | 4 | 10.00 |
| 22 | 14 | 10.00 |
| 23 | 15 | 20.00 |
